map.K≥1 仅为快速校核，正式须按 JGJ 130 验算并满足构造要求: K≥1 is only a quick check; formally you must verify against JGJ 130 and satisfy the detailing requirements
map.K≥1 表示不考虑缺陷时满足，但实际脚手架含初弯曲、节点松动等，规范另有稳定承载: K≥1 means the requirement is met when defects are ignored, but a real scaffold has initial bow, loose joints and so on, and the code provides separate stability capacity formulas plus detailing requirements; K serves only as a quick check and formal verification must follow JGJ130.

map.合格判定：安全系数 K≥1 为安全: Acceptance rule: a safety factor K≥1 means safe
map.安全系数 K≥1 就够了吗？: Is a safety factor K≥1 enough?

map.扣件式脚手架立杆稳定性安全验算 使用指南: Couplet scaffold upright stability safety check usage guide

map.支持调整步距、连墙件设置复核稳定性: Supports adjusting the step spacing and the wall tie settings to recheck stability
map.查看安全系数 K，K≥1 判定为安全: Check the safety factor K; K>=1 is judged safe
map.沿海/大风地区还须考虑风振与体型系数，不可忽略: Coastal or high-wind areas must also account for wind vibration and the shape coefficient; it cannot be ignored
map.点击计算，读取长细比、稳定系数与组合应力: Click calculate to read the slenderness ratio, the stability coefficient and the combined stress
map.脚手架安全验算：按立杆稳定性公式验算轴力、长细比、稳定系数与安全系数: Scaffold safety check: check the axial force, slenderness ratio, stability coefficient and safety factor with the upright stability formula
map.计入风弯矩计算组合应力: Includes the wind moment in the combined stress
map.轴力 N=1.2×(立杆自重+构配件重)+1.4×施工荷载；长细比 λ=步距×1: Axial force N=1.2x(self weight of the upright + fittings) + 1.4xconstruction load; slenderness ratio λ = spacing x 1000 / radius of gyration i (take i=15.8mm for Φ48x3.5); the stability coefficient φ is interpolated from a table by λ; the stress σ=N x 1000/(φ x A) + Mw x 10...
map.输入基本风压与风载参数（如需校核风载）: Enter the basic wind pressure and wind load parameters (if you need to check wind load)
map.输入立杆轴向力、计算长度/步距与截面特性: Enter the upright axial force, the effective length / spacing and the section properties
map.输入钢材强度设计值与稳定系数 φ: Enter the design strength of the steel and the stability coefficient φ
map.输出安全系数 K 并给出合格判定: Outputs the safety factor K and gives an acceptance verdict
map.长细比过大显著降低稳定系数，应控制步距并按规定设置连墙件: An excessive slenderness ratio markedly lowers the stability coefficient, so control the spacing and set the wall ties as required
map.风弯矩什么时候不能忽略？: When can the wind moment not be ignored?
map.风载校核：计入风弯矩组合应力: Wind load check: include the wind moment in the combined stress
map.高脚手架或大风压地区风弯矩显著（本例约占总应力 1/3），须用正确基本风压 w₀: For tall scaffolds or high wind pressure areas the wind moment is significant (about 1/3 of the total stress in this example), so the correct basic wind pressure w₀ is required
map.高脚手架或大风压地区风弯矩显著，本例 Mw 约占总应力 1/3；沿海地区须用正确: For tall scaffolds or high wind pressure areas the wind moment is significant; in this example Mw is about 1/3 of the total stress. Coastal areas need the correct basic wind pressure w₀ and must account for wind vibration.
